site_name: Isleworth And Syon School For Boys
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PR37740/3000, received 6 July 2011;  PR37740/302/A and PR37740/301/A received 4 Jan 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The Landscaping shown on the approved drawings shall be completed prior to erection of the fence and shall be permanently retained.  Any trees or shrubs that die within five years of planting shall be replaced with comparable species during the next available planting season
Condition : 4 - The fencing is to be coloured dark green and so maintained permanently
description: Provision of 2.5 metre high ball stop fencing to enclose existing artifical turf sports pitch including landscaping and planting
